test_item_verbatim: · The Head Unit shall provide power to the RVCM within 500ms when STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts = [RUN OR IGN_START] is received. a) The Head Unit shall transmit PowerShutDownNotifcation.Power_Down = [False].

tcs.tc_title: power to the RVCM within 500 ms, Atl-Mi, switch the ignition to RUN and check the supply timing and the notification
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in Standby state
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. CAN source: BCM_FD_10.CmdIgnSts (HDCC27, DT27) / STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts (637, 2261, 376)
4. A bus analyzer is connected to the LVDS link between the HU and the RVCM
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts = 4 (RUN)
2. Read the bus analyzer recording and check the time between step 1 and the supply to the RVCM
3. Read the bus analyzer recording and check the PowerShutDownNotifcation message
tcs.expected_result:
1. STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts = 4 (RUN) is sent
2. The HU supplies power to the RVCM within 500 ms of step 1
3. PowerShutDownNotifcation.Power_Down = False is transmitted
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
tcs.split_reason: power to the RVCM within 500 ms, Atl-Mi
tcs.test_item:
· The Head Unit shall provide power to the RVCM within 500ms when STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts = [RUN OR IGN_START] is received. a) The Head Unit shall transmit PowerShutDownNotifcation.Power_Down = [False].

(power to the RVCM within 500 ms, Atl-Mi, switch the ignition to RUN and check the supply timing and the notification)

reasoning: 驗證目標為 `SYS-RA-VF551_V3-205` 之「收到 `STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts = [RUN OR IGN_START]` 後 500 ms 內對 RVCM 供電」與其 `a)` 子句「送 `Power_Down = [False]`」。原句 29 token，未逾 50，主句與 a) 子句一併保留（同一觸發之連帶後果，§5.7 多行 ER）。供試取 `RUN`；`IGN_START` 為同一 OR 分支之另一值，其 ER 相同，不另拆（§8.3 無新驗證點）。**車型勾三 Atl-Mi** —— V42（637）之對應來源 `SYS-RA-VF551_V42-216`／`-219` 依 R-CAM10 委派 `SWE-CAM-006`（Video Pipeline），V33（2261）無同義條文，故本列為 Atl-Mi 側唯一承接者。**LVDS 之觀察不造命令**（升級條件 2 之處置）—— 交付語料 17 本之 `$ ` 命令行 275 條**無一條與 LVDS 相關**（`lvds`／`PowerShutDownNotifcation`／`vehicleUpdate` 三串零命中）；`sources/raw/*sysad*` 之 10 本 docx 亦零命中。故 ER 以 bus analyzer 之訊息名與值書寫，procedure 之觀察步依 §5.4 兩行式但第二行為 bus analyzer 之動作而非 shell 命令。
